renderContract.commonPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: premium choice-protected-value close-emotion guardian card master artwork, full-bleed 3:4. Show exactly the named single guardian or canonical internal pair and no extra adviser, partner, audience, future self, human, silhouette, reflection, empty seat or implied person. Preserve canonical identity, approved white-sclera purple eye construction, colors, clothing, signature props, dark-purple outlines and visible chest Stella stars. Guardian or pair plus one protected core and one visibly separate adjustable or relinquishable control covers 55–65% and reads at 80px. Frame the face and hand closely while leaving a broad outside margin; show desire and fear without declaring a correct choice, permanent defense, certainty, destiny or guaranteed outcome. Written surfaces use isolated symbols and geometric reliefs only: no readable text, pseudo-text, names, labels, score, number, date, clock face, calendar grid, map coordinate, question mark, zodiac glyph, arrow route, logo or watermark. Do not bake actual birth-chart lines or personal colors into the master art. Boundaries remain broken, C-shaped, open-notched, removable or unlatched; no closed circle, ring, halo, portal, infinity sign, cage, locked box or deterministic route. Replace literal keys with loose seal or boundary tokens. Do not add a scale; no scale is requested in this batch. Only Scorpio canonical tail-heart is allowed; no added heart. Keep every composition distinct. Soft colored-pencil and watercolor, visible paper grain, rounded plush proportions and dreamy violet-peach-gold lighting; no readable text, no logo, no watermark.
